_note: Two parts. Part A is JON'S explicit weights — Jon edits this file directly to shift focus over time; agents must not write to Part A. Part B is BEHAVIOR signals captured by agents from feedback events — agents update Part B from .config/dialogue.md feedback parsing + the ntfy feedback topic poll.
reader_context_one_line: Curious technically-literate generalist on Long Island, NY. Reads the morning issue with coffee, the afternoon update during the workday lull. Wants the curve, the numbers, the named people, the real links.

part_a_explicit_weights._note: Edited by Jon directly. Agents must not change these values automatically. Sum of sp_index_weights must be 1.0.
part_a_explicit_weights._weights_rationale: Jon's seed: robotics gets the largest single weight (0.20) per his explicit 'I want robotics included' direction; autonomy_horizon and capability_sota co-anchor the cognitive curve at 0.18 each; ai_doing_science weighted higher than release_velocity per his explicit interest in 'predictions and trends'; open_frontier_proximity and bci_bandwidth at the bottom but non-zero.
part_a_explicit_weights.section_preferences: Open. Edit this string to direct curation tone if a recurring theme is missing. As of v8 launch: no overrides.
part_a_explicit_weights.voice_preferences: Open. Edit this string if voice drifts. As of v8 launch: no overrides — Karpathy-meets-Stratechery per VISION.md stands.

part_b_behavior_signals._note: Maintained by agents. Updated each fire from the past 24h of feedback events. 30-day rolling windows.

jons_pulse_target_render._note: How agents should compute and render Jon's Pulse. Same 8 component scores as canonical SP-Index, but weighted per part_a.sp_index_weights instead of canonical weights. Render BOTH numbers side-by-side at the top of every issue.
